source_xy_policy: Keep the bounded x and y axes at extent 3, their coordinates, empty/X/O cell values, X-first alternating turns, and the existing placement, restart, and quit behavior. Add no gravity.
neighborhood: Winning lines use straight, contiguous triples along the three axes and all face and body diagonals: 27 axial lines, 18 face diagonals, and 4 body diagonals, for 49 lines total.
movement: On a turn, place the current player's mark in any empty (x,y,z) cell. Reject occupied or out-of-bounds targets without changing state. Do not allow placements after a win or draw. Restart resets all 27 cells and the turn; quit retains its Source behavior.
outcomes: After each legal placement, a line of three matching marks anywhere in the cube wins for its owner. Check wins before declaring a draw; a draw requires every cube cell occupied and no winning line.
presentation: Show the board as one continuous cube volume using the engine-owned cell shells, 3D positions, colliders, and overview camera. Display X and O in their occupied cells and retain turn, winner, and draw status.
input: Click a cube cell to supply its full (x,y,z) coordinate. Use the engine-provided '[' and ']' keys or on-screen buttons to select a depth layer when picking inner cells. Retain R to restart and Escape to quit.
z_equals_one_tests: With z at extent 1, legal placements and occupied-cell rejection must match the Source 3×3 board.
With z at extent 1, exactly the Source rows, columns, and two diagonals win; a full board without a line draws.
With z at extent 1, X moves first, turns alternate, and restart restores the Source initial state.
